hypotheses.title: Customer Reversal & Volatility-Adjusted Delta with 4-Day Decay Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines 6/7 PASS Candidate A (Sharpe 1.25, Sub-universe 0.75) by applying ts_decay_linear(..., 4) directly to the volatility-adjusted 3-day delta component and expanding the customer reversal threshold to >0.5. This directly suppresses turnover from 34% down to ~15-18%, boosting Fitness past 1.00 for full Gate G4-G7 approval.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if decay smoothing degrades Sharpe below 1.25.

candidates.rationale: Customer reversal (>0.5) with 4-day linearly smoothed volatility-adjusted delta
